name: playlish
description: Lightweight, plugin-friendly Spotify desktop client (unofficial, not affiliated with Spotify)

scripts.build: tsc -p tsconfig.main.json && tsc -p tsconfig.renderer.json && node scripts/build-ui.mjs && node scripts/build-assets.mjs
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p tsconfig.main.json --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.renderer.json --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.ui.json && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.e2e.json --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.tools.json && tsc -p tsconfig.examples.json
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm test
scripts.perf:idle: npm run build && node tools/perf/run.ts --scenario idle
scripts.perf:ui: npm run build && node tools/perf/run.ts --scenario ui
scripts.perf:soak: npm run build && node tools/perf/run.ts --scenario soak --minutes 30
